tips.text: Spend your crown at a Golden Hand Tribute early, then kill that mission's Treasurer on the way out for the next crown.
Run solo with a nuke frame; every extra squad member adds 25 kills to each rank and splits the Specters' aggro.
Bring Octavia, drop Mallet and Amp at the spawn point and barely move.
Bring Mesa's Peacemaker with a full energy pool, or Revenant's Danse Macabre from a slight rise.
Use the Xoris if you have no nuke frame; its Charged Throw kills any Errant Specter and frees a trapped Solaris for 20 more seconds.
Try Iliad instead of Skyresh for the Barrel.
Try Triton, Neptune Rescue, instead of Adrastea for the Receiver.
Bring Team Energy Restores or an ammo-efficient weapon.
Abort and restart if you spawn on the tile with the giant coin and every Tribute is inactive.
Expect around 7 to 10 missions, often under an hour, since each run refills the next crown.
